about: What species each tree near a viewpoint's camera is (task 061), as a session saw it in the viewpoint's photo and the reference photos (refs/photos.json), as refs/buildings.json holds the facades seen; tools/trees.mjs's kindOf takes it before anything else. species: what each name is, its kind (tools/trees.mjs's KINDS) and whether it keeps its leaves (leaves: deciduous or evergreen); broadleaf is a broadleaf the photo can't name. trees: each tree seen, at: its crown's middle as the world had it when it was seen (braga-map 1.26.0's cx, cz), which names the tree of the map whose crown's middle is nearest, within half its crown's width or 3 m; species null where it's hidden in the photo (behind a trunk, a building or other trees); seen: the photo it was looked at in (viewpoint:<id>, or a reference photo's id); sure: false where the photo shows the tree small, dark, half hidden or bare, or the tree of the map is a piece of a bigger crown. Every tree within 60 m of a viewpoint's camera and in its view (tools/species.mjs) is here, but for the skylines'. rows: a species lining a stretch of street, as photos along it show it: every tree whose trunk stands within `within` metres of `line` is of it, but those seen. areas: a species filling a place: every tree whose trunk stands in `ring`, but those seen and those of a row.

areas.name: Parque da Ponte
areas.notes: Its canopy from the chapel's Largo to the roundabout and round the bandstand: limes, their heart-shaped leaves against the sky and their crowns in flower in June (landmark-parque-da-ponte-2); a few planes among them (seen). COS2025 has the park's wood as a eucalyptus one.
